newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui O.S.K to buy building from Mitsui Fudosan.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui O.S.K to buy building from Mitsui Fudosan.

text.p: Mitsui O.S.K. Lines Ltd said on Wednesday it would buy a building in central Tokyo that it has rented for years for use as its headquarters on April 1 as a way to cut costs.
Real estate company Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd, which owns the building, will sell it for 37 billion yen for a profit of 25.03 billion yen, a Mitsui Fudosan spokesman said.

A Mitsui O.S.K. official said the purchase would have a positive impact on the shipping company's earnings in the long term. The company had concluded that it would be cheaper to own the headquarters than to continue paying rent, he said.

The Mitsui Fudosan spokesman said profits from the sale of the building would be included in the company's earnings for the year to March 31, 1998. He declined to provide an earnings forecast for 1997/98.
Both companies are members of the Mitsui group.
